findings.message: The audio decoded with the correction file has the CRC 6b0cb5c2, but the header stores 30faeec2 as the CRC of the lossless audio: the correction file is not this file's, or one of them is damaged.
The audio decoded with built-legacy-pair-bit-flipped.wvc does not have the CRC the file's header states for the lossless audio; it is not counted as the lossless pair of the file.
